messages.subject: GoogleChart is not working
parts:
Hi all, Package googlecharts is not working in R Studio - "Error in library(googleCharts) :  there is no package called ‘googleCharts’". How to solve this ?

When installing the package getting the following error
> install.packages("googlecharts")
Installing package into ‘C:/Users/Surendrakumar/Documents/R/win-library/3.2’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘googlecharts’ is not available (for R version 3.2.1)

How to update the R version which is in R - Studio ?

messages.author: fd2fc7e46319d1dd
messages.subject: Re: GoogleChart is not working
parts:
Hi,

I think the package you want to install is the following : https://github.com/jcheng5/googleCharts, am I right ?
If that's so, you need to use the following command lines in order to install it :

if (!require(devtools))
  install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("jcheng5/googleCharts")

Then you should be able to load it with : library(googleCharts) .

Also, it seems that this package is specific for use in a shiny app, but if you just want google charts outside a shiny app, you have the "googleVis" package which should work too.

HTH :)

Best regards.
